# Vendored frontend libraries

Served from our own origin so the kiosk does not depend on a CDN.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap (CSS + bundle JS) | 5.3.8 | npm `bootstrap` | MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons (font) | 1.13.2 | npm `bootstrap-icons` | MIT |
| Chart.js (UMD build) | 4.5.1 | npm `chart.js` | MIT |
| html5-qrcode | 2.3.8 | npm `html5-qrcode` | Apache-2.0 |

To update, `npm pack <name>@<version>`, copy the same files, and update this table.
